biography: James Egozi wasn't born into racing royalty; his path was paved with grit and the pungent smell of two-stroke oil. Growing up in a small town with a surprisingly vibrant karting scene, James spent his childhood tearing around local tracks, fueled by a relentless desire to win. His father, a mechanic, tinkered endlessly with his kart, instilling a deep understanding of machinery. A defining moment came at the 'Karting Cup' when, after starting last due to a qualifying mishap, he carved his way through the pack to snatch victory on the final corner, showcasing his raw talent and never-give-up attitude. The win caught the eye of 'Kart 2-Stroke 125cc Direct', a team known for nurturing young talent. Now, at 30, James finds himself at the peak of his karting career, a seasoned veteran still hungry for championships. He continues to compete in the karting league, balancing his racing career with his role as a mentor to aspiring young karters, passing on the lessons he learned the hard way.
drivingStyle: James is a calculating driver, known for his meticulous approach to every race. He studies track maps and telemetry data obsessively, searching for the slightest advantage. In corners, he favors a smooth, controlled entry, maximizing mid-corner speed and setting up precise exits. He's a master of tire management, able to conserve rubber throughout a race while still maintaining competitive pace. Under pressure, James remains remarkably composed, making him a formidable opponent in wheel-to-wheel battles.

rivalries.name: Marco Bellini
rivalries.reason: A fierce rivalry stemming from a controversial collision at the Karting Cup, where Bellini accused Egozi of deliberate contact.

rivalries.name: Anya Petrova
rivalries.reason: A strategic rivalry; Petrova's team often employs tactics that James finds unsportsmanlike, leading to heated on-track clashes.

rivalries.name: Kenji Tanaka
rivalries.reason: A long-standing rivalry based on mutual respect and intense competition, pushing both drivers to constantly improve.

quirks: Always wears the same pair of lucky socks, regardless of the weather.
Listens to classical music to calm his nerves before a race.
Meticulously cleans his visor before every session, believing a clear view is essential for success.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't just about speed; it's about understanding the machine, the track, and yourself."
careerHighlight: Winning the Karting World Championship after a season-long battle with his arch-rival, securing his place as one of the sport's elite.
careerLowPoint: Suffering a mechanical failure while leading the championship race, costing him the title by a single point.
